Six weeks of focused power endurance training for advanced climbers

This 6-week program is designed for sport climbers with a lot of experience with structured training that would like to prepare for pumpy sport climbs. The template is designed to be split across three training days per week.  

The first training day can be completed at a boulder wall and should consist of the Warm Up, followed by either Campus Laddering (weeks 1-3), Style Triad (Weeks 3 & 6), or Broken Quarters (weeks 4 & 5).  

The second training day will consist of the Route Warm Up Protocol followed by Route Pyramids & Capacity Power (except for week 3).  

The third training day will consist of the Finger Strength Testing Session on week 1 and then on the remaining weeks will consist of 7:3s 50-60% repeaters.  The repeaters workouts can be done after max strength fingerboarding, but should not be done before strength training.  

Additional sessions can be added to this plan to maintain base endurance or strength & power.
